title: crataegus alpina
intro: Crataegus alpina, commonly known as Alpine Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. Alpine Hawthorn has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Hawthorn are attributed to its ability to modulate the cardiovascular system, improve lipid profiles, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
